Test Procedure: Submit bugs of varying impact (crash/data loss, major feature failure, partial failure, cosmetic issue) and view the Triage Agent output.
Condition to be tested: Bug descriptions represent Critical, High, Medium, and Low severity.
Expected Result: Triage Agent should classify each bug with the correct severity: Critical, High, Medium, or Low.
Actual Result: Severity classified correctly for all bugs.

Test Procedure: Submit bugs of varying impact and urgency and check the priority assigned by the Triage Agent.
Condition to be tested: Priority depends on bug impact and urgency.
Expected Result: Agent should assign an appropriate priority consistent with impact and urgency.

Test Procedure: Submit a bug mentioning a specific module (e.g., authentication, file upload) and check the component field.
Condition to be tested: Bug description contains component/module information.
Expected Result: Agent should identify the correct affected software component.

Test Procedure: Submit a bug and check the confidence score and reasoning in the Triage Agent output.
Condition to be tested: Confidence score and reasoning are generated with each classification.
Expected Result: A valid confidence score and a short explanation for severity, priority, and component should be displayed.
Actual Result: Confidence score and reasoning displayed correctly.

Test Procedure: Submit a bug and validate the Triage Agent output against the defined schema.
Condition to be tested: Output follows the defined structured schema.
Expected Result: Output should contain severity, priority, component, confidence, and reasoning in valid structured format.

Test Procedure: Submit a bug with a stack trace containing an exception (e.g., NullPointerException) and check the Log Analysis output.
Condition to be tested: Stack trace/logs contain an exception type and error message.
Expected Result: Agent should identify the exception type and extract the relevant error message.
Actual Result: Exception type and error message extracted correctly.

Test Procedure: Submit a stack trace with file, class, method, and line number and check the failure point.
Condition to be tested: Stack trace includes failure location details.
Expected Result: Agent should identify file name, class, method, and line number of the failure.

Test Procedure: Submit a multi-frame stack trace and check the identified code path.
Condition to be tested: Stack trace has a sequence of call entries.
Expected Result: Agent should identify the probable affected code path from the stack-trace sequence.

Test Procedure: Submit stack traces in different formats (Java, Python, JavaScript) and check the output.
Condition to be tested: Logs are in varied stack-trace formats.
Expected Result: Agent should parse every supported format successfully.

Test Procedure: Submit a stack trace and validate the Log Analysis Agent output against the schema.
Condition to be tested: Output follows the defined structured schema.
Expected Result: Output should contain exception type, error message, failure point, code path, and confidence score.

Test Procedure: Submit a new bug with description, stack trace, and logs through the Bug Submission Module and observe agent execution.
Condition to be tested: New bug submission triggers both agents.
Expected Result: Triage and Log Analysis agents should run automatically, each receiving its appropriate input.
Actual Result: Both agents triggered with correct inputs.

Test Procedure: Submit a bug and view the combined output after both agents complete.
Condition to be tested: Both agent outputs are available.
Expected Result: Outputs should be merged into a single common structured bug context.

Test Procedure: Submit a bug and check that the bug context can be consumed by a downstream agent.
Condition to be tested: Bug context is needed by Milestone 3 agents.
Expected Result: Triage and Log Analysis outputs should be passed as context to downstream agents.
Actual Result: Context passed to downstream agents correctly.

Test Procedure: Submit a bug with only a description and no logs or stack trace.
Condition to be tested: Log data is missing.
Expected Result: System should handle the missing logs gracefully and still complete triage.

Test Procedure: Submit malformed input, and separately simulate a failure in one agent.
Condition to be tested: Input is invalid, or an agent fails/returns incomplete analysis.
Expected Result: System should show an appropriate error or fallback and not crash.
Actual Result: Invalid input and agent failure handled correctly.

Test Procedure: Submit multiple bugs with different inputs and verify the complete flow.
Condition to be tested: Multiple bug submissions are processed.
Expected Result: Each bug should be processed end-to-end with correct combined output.

Test Procedure: Submit bugs with only a description, description with stack trace, only logs, and messy unstructured logs.
Condition to be tested: Bug inputs vary in format and completeness.
Expected Result: Agents should produce accurate outputs for every input type without failing.

Test Procedure: Run the seeded dataset through the Triage Agent and compare predictions with expected labels.
Condition to be tested: Seeded dataset has expected severity, priority, and component labels.
Expected Result: Accuracy for severity, priority, and component should be calculated and reported.

Test Procedure: Run the seeded dataset through the Log Analysis Agent and compare predictions with verified results.
Condition to be tested: Seeded dataset has verified exception, failure point, and code path.
Expected Result: Accuracy for exception type, failure point, and code path should be calculated and reported.

Test Procedure: Record incorrect predictions, update prompts/rules/parsing logic, and re-run the tests.
Condition to be tested: Some predictions differ from expected labels.
Expected Result: Common failure cases should be identified and accuracy should improve after refinement.
Actual Result: Failure cases analyzed and accuracy improved.
